translation.proposed_text_en: However, recovery shall not take place if: 1. the building society transfers the amount to be recovered, with the consent of the taxpayer, to the competent Regional Finance Directorate; 2. in the cases of paragraph (6), the repaid contributions or the security serve for favored measures within the meaning of Section 18(1) item 3, in which case recovery shall also not take place if the measures are implemented by or for the persons referred to in paragraph (2).
issues: Corrected Finanzlandesdirektion from Regional Tax Office to Regional Finance Directorate and rendered begünstigte Maßnahmen as favored measures rather than subsidised measures.
